free_tier.stated: No free tier stated: a paid plan or prepaid credits are required to launch computers; without a plan, pay as you go from prepaid credits at $0.12 an hour for a Standard computer.

per_object_cap.stated: Files of up to 2 GiB go into a computer as a resumable upload, sent in chunks and picked up again after a dropped connection.

retention.stated: Files, logins and installed software stay on the computer between sessions; scheduled snapshots keep 7 daily history on Solo, and Swarm adds 4 weekly and 12 monthly, but schedules are not enabled by default.

egress.terms: Computers reach the internet through an address shared with other customers; each computer has its own network policy, and up to 2 public URLs per computer on Solo are served under mandala.dev. No egress volume allowance or per-GB price is stated on the pricing or terms page.

interface_detail: REST API, Python and TypeScript SDKs, an MCP server and a command-line client; the desktop is driven by screenshot, click, type, key and exec inside the session.
tooling: pip install mandala-computer, npm install mandala-computer, the mandala CLI, or an MCP client pointed at the hosted MCP server; an API key from Settings is required.
chaining: A persistent Linux desktop with a shell and browser can run an agent that writes its checkpoints to object storage; the shared outbound address makes a dedicated IP from an egress record necessary for any service that keys on source address.

limits.value: Solo: 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM and 80 GB storage pool, up to 4 computers, up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM per computer; 7-day snapshot history
uploads into a computer are limited to files of up to 2 GiB
a paid plan or prepaid credits, an account and an API key are required before a computer can be created

limits_note: A built-in agent run stops after 60 minutes; a monthly plan's snapshot history is 7 daily on Solo and up to 12 monthly on Swarm.
binding_note: No free lane exists and a computer cannot be launched without a paid plan or prepaid credits, so the payment and API-key gate fails before the 4-vCPU pool or the 2 GiB upload cap.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers Continue with GitHub and Continue with Google; the terms require the user to be at least 18 and to provide a working email address. A paid plan or prepaid credits bought through Stripe are required to launch a computer; no phone or ID document is asked for on the pages read.

reliability_note: Computers may be suspended when idle and published services carry no uptime commitment; snapshots are not scheduled by default, and an account out of credit for 30 days may have its computers deleted after a seven-day warning.
confidence_note: The price, pool limits, upload cap, sign-up methods and shared-address term are quoted from the vendor's own pages read on 2026-11-24.
